intro: The Apex dresser makes getting ready easy. A built-in mirror, sturdy metal frame, & spacious storage keep essentials at hand, while smooth edges and eco-friendly materials make it a family favourite.

features.title: A mirror that works for you
features.text: Our integrated mirror enhances your dressing routine while adding a sleek, modern touch to your space.

features.title: Built for strength, made to last
features.text: A sturdy metal pipe frame ensures long-lasting durability, so your dresser stays reliable for years to come.

features.title: Smart storage, effortless organisation
features.text: A spacious utility drawer keeps your essentials neatly stored, so everything you need is always within reach.

features.title: Designed with the planet in mind
features.text: Crafted from low-VOC, E1-grade materials, our dresser promotes better indoor air quality while being environmentally responsible.

features.title: Smooth edges for added safety
features.text: Rounded edges reduce the risk of bumps and scrapes, making our dresser a safe and stylish choice for any home.

Prelaminated Particle Board and MDF Board
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
